items.name: Corn on the cob (2 short cob rounds, kernels only)
items.fdc_query: Corn, sweet, yellow, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt
items.preparation: boiled or steamed, cut crosswise into two short cob sections, served plain

fdc.description: Corn, sweet, yellow, cooked, boiled, drained, with salt

rows: Corn, sweet, yellow, frozen, kernels on cob, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

scale_cues: White square plate assumed to be about 25 cm across; each cob round is about 5 cm in diameter relative to the plate. The overhead view hides the thickness of the sections, which I assumed to be about 3 cm.
assumptions: Mass is the edible kernels only, excluding the inedible cob; total weight with cob would be about 100-120 g.
Each section is assumed to be about 3 cm thick, since the overhead angle hides height.
No butter, oil or seasoning is visible, so none is included.
Corn is assumed to be cooked (boiled or steamed) rather than raw.
